result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
ShawX Manufacturing

ShawX Manufacturing is a proudly Australian-owned engineering and manufacturing company based in Queensland, specialising in innovative heavy vehicle solutions for the construction, mining, transport, and waste management industries.
As our business continues to grow, we are looking for motivated and hands-on Metal Fabricators to join our team in Cleveland.

Job summary:

The Metal Fabricator is responsible for fabricating, assembling, modifying, and repairing metal components and structures in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications, and production requirements. The role involves preparing metal materials, cutting, shaping, welding, assembling, finishing, and inspecting fabricated products to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with workplace safety standards.
The position requires practical skills in metal fabrication, welding processes, interpretation of technical drawings, and the safe operation of fabrication equipment.

Responsibilities:
-  Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, work instructions, and specifications to determine job requirements.
-  Measure, mark, cut, shape, and prepare metal materials including steel, aluminium, and other fabricated components.
-  Select appropriate materials, tools, and fabrication methods for each job.
-  Fabricate metal components and assemblies using hand tools, power tools, and workshop machinery.
-  Assemble fabricated components using welding, bolting, fastening, and mechanical joining techniques.
-  Ensure fabricated products meet dimensional accuracy and quality requirements.
-  Perform welding operations using appropriate welding techniques
-  Set up welding equipment and select suitable welding parameters based on material type and thickness.
-  Align and position components prior to welding.
-  Inspect welds for quality, penetration, appearance, and structural integrity.
-  Carry out welding repairs, modifications, and rework where required.
-  Operate fabrication equipment such as cutting saws, grinders, drills and other metal processing equipment
-  Cut metal sections and shapes according to drawings and measurements.
-  Shape and modify metal components using mechanical methods and controlled heating where required.
-  Grind, clean, dress, and finish fabricated components.
-  Check finished products against drawings, measurements, and customer specifications.
-  Identify fabrication defects and complete corrective work.
-  Maintain quality standards throughout the fabrication process.

Qualification & Skills
-  Trade qualification in Metal Fabrication or equivalent qualification
-  3+ years of experience in metal fabrication within a workshop/manufacturing environment
-  Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans.
-  Experience with metal cutting, grinding, welding, and assembly processes.
-  Ability to measure and mark metal accurately.
-  Experience using hand tools and workshop machinery.
-  Understanding of welding processes and fabrication techniques.
-  Ability to work independently and as part of a production team.

Why Join ShawX?
-  Be part of a growing Australian manufacturing success story
-  Work on innovative and specialised heavy vehicle products
-  Supportive team environment with opportunities to grow your skills
-  Stable full-time position with competitive pay
-  Opportunity to contribute to industry-leading manufacturing solutions

Pay 
- AUD 79500 - 85000 per annum excluding superannuation 

If you are looking for a rewarding hands-on role within a growing business, we would love to hear from you.

Summary: 
Join an organisation that is shaping the future direction of software engineering in Australia, in an academic role that combines high-quality research, excellent teaching, and meaningful contribution to the School’s strategic priorities.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. In this role, you will contribute to the advancement of research and education in modern computing systems, while helping to shape the next generation of computing professionals.

You will conduct research in areas including AI for Software Engineering, Software Engineering for AI, AI Application Engineering, Software Development Lifecycle and Software Architectures. Through your research, you will contribute to high-impact scholarly outcomes, collaborative research initiatives and the School's growing international reputation in Software Engineering.

With established strengths across Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computer Systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for academics seeking to build their research profile, contribute to interdisciplinary collaboration and deliver outstanding teaching. This is an opportunity to join one of Australia's leading Computer Science and Engineering schools, supported by world-class facilities, strong industry partnerships and a culture of innovation and impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative research environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to sustainability, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with expertise in Software Engineering and a passion for both research and teaching. You will have the ability to contribute to high-quality research outcomes while delivering engaging and innovative learning experiences for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable). 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement. 
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
•	Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students.
•	Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If this opportunity interests you, but your experience does not align perfectly with every selection criterion, we still encourage you to apply.

UNI-SPAN HEIGHT SAFETY PTY LTD is the Australian entity of the broader Uni-Span Group, a specialist in formwork and scaffolding solutions for construction and infrastructure projects. Operating since at least 2006, the company provides and hires out Quickstage scaffolding systems, custom formwork solutions, and engineering support, serving industries such as civil, commercial, and power generation.

We are seeking skilled and qualified Scaffolders to join our team in NSW and QLD.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Determining job requirements and planning/configuring scaffolding
Undertake checking and assessing activities of scaffold prior to, during and at the completion of each build
Erecting lifting tackles by attaching pulleys and blocks to fixed overhead structures, and installing cables and attaching counterweights
Attaching slinging gear to hoisting equipment and objects to be moved using clamps, hooks, bolts and knots
Fitting and bolting tubes, support braces and components to form bases and build up scaffolding
Lifting and positioning sections of scaffolding
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Dismantling and removing on completion
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Fixing mesh and reinforcing steel into position in formwork for concrete pours
Setting up winches and rigging equipment to raise and position girders, plates, columns and other steel units
Erecting guard rails, guy wires, ropes and clears, laying planks and hanging safety nets
Help identify hazards, defects and the need for adjustment or repair; to ensure compliance with agreed codes, law, working practices and health and safety
Maintain accurate records of inspection and hand over
Where possible, rectify identified defects, failures, errors or omissions to scaffold structures. If not possible ensure reporting to the required personnel and restrict access to structure until such time the defect is rectified
Adhere to all organisational and customer policies, procedures and Safety Health Management System requirements
Ensure all scaffold, temporary works and other scaffold related activities are undertaken in accordance with Australian Standards and the relevant states Code of Practice

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Demonstratable working experience of at least 3 years in a similar role within the Construction and Maintenance industries
High Risk Work Licence (SB, SI or SA)
Proven experience erecting, maintaining and dismantling Scaffolding structures in the Port, Coal, Construction and Maintenance industries
Working at Heights Competency
Confined Space Entry Competency
Gas Test Atmospheres Competency
Coal Board Medical and Standard 11 Induction Competency
Desirable: Any or combination of Work Platform (WP), Forklift Truck (LF), Intermediate Rigger (RI), Dogger (DG) or Non-Slew Crane (CN) High Risk Work Licence/s
Construction Industry Induction – Blue/White Card
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong commitment to hassle free customer service
Strong commitment to health, safety, environment and compliance standards
Willingness to work extended hours, shift work or hours as required to achieve positive outcomes
Desire to lead a highly driven team to achieve successful outcomes for both the customer and in turn, MI Scaffold
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
